summary: Removes a target's Insubstantial State within 20' and prevents it for 30 seconds; auto-Insubstantial Enchantments like Gift of Air fail and are removed.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Only happens if the target is currently Insubstantial; the ability may also be cast on players who are not (E2).

effects.subject: target
effects.note: Target may not become Insubstantial for 30 seconds.

effects.subject: target
effects.note: While Planar Grounding is in effect, Enchantments that automatically render their bearer Insubstantial (such as Gift of Air) fail and are removed if they activate.

references.name: Gift of Air
references.note: Named as an example: fails and is removed if it activates while Planar Grounding is in effect.

clarifications.text: May be cast on players who are not currently Insubstantial (to prevent them becoming Insubstantial).
Enchantments that automatically make their bearer Insubstantial, such as Gift of Air, fail and are removed if they activate while Planar Grounding is in effect.

open_questions: N1 'fail': does the rest of the failing Enchantment's activation (e.g. Gift of Air ignoring the triggering hit) also not happen? The plain reading is that the whole activation fails.
